mapper.select: SELECT department.id, department.name, department.active, department.created_at, count(DISTINCT role_assignment.id) FILTER (WHERE role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL) AS administrator_count, count(DISTINCT device.id) AS device_count FROM public.department AS department LEFT JOIN public.account_department_role AS role_assignment ON role_assignment.department_id = department.id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' LEFT JOIN public.device AS device ON device.department_id = department.id GROUP BY department.id ORDER BY lower(department.name), department.id

SELECT department.id, department.name, department.active, department.created_at, count(DISTINCT role_assignment.id) FILTER (WHERE role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL) AS administrator_count, count(DISTINCT device.id) AS device_count FROM public.department AS department LEFT JOIN public.account_department_role AS role_assignment ON role_assignment.department_id = department.id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' LEFT JOIN public.device AS device ON device.department_id = department.id WHERE department.id = #{departmentId} GROUP BY department.id
INSERT INTO public.department(name) VALUES (#{name}) RETURNING id

SELECT account.id, account.username, account.status, role_assignment.assigned_at FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = role_assignment.account_id WHERE role_assignment.department_id = #{departmentId} AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(account.username), account.id
SELECT id, device_code, name, status, last_seen_at FROM public.device WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY lower(name), id

SELECT account.id, account.username, account.system_role, account.status, account.password_changed_at, account.created_at, coalesce( string_agg( department.name, ', ' ORDER BY lower(department.name)) FILTER (WHERE role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL), '') AS department_names FROM public.account AS account LEFT JOIN public.account_department_role AS role_assignment ON role_assignment.account_id = account.id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' LEFT JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = role_assignment.department_id GROUP BY account.id ORDER BY lower(account.username), account.id
SELECT id, username, password_hash, system_role, status, password_changed_at, created_at FROM public.account WHERE id = #{accountId}
SELECT id, username, password_hash, system_role, status, password_changed_at, created_at FROM public.account WHERE id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO public.account(username, system_role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{systemRole}, 'PENDING_SETUP') RETURNING id
SELECT count(*) FROM public.account WHERE id != #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND system_role = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN'
mapper.update: UPDATE public.account SET status = 'DISABLED' WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status IN ('PENDING_SETUP', 'ACTIVE')
UPDATE public.account SET status = CASE WHEN password_hash IS NULL THEN 'PENDING_SETUP' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 'DISABLED'
mapper.select: SELECT role_assignment.id, role_assignment.department_id, department.name AS department_name, role_assignment.assigned_at FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = role_assignment.department_id WHERE role_assignment.account_id = #{accountId} AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(department.name), department.id

INSERT INTO public.account_department_role( account_id, department_id, role, assigned_by_account_id, assigned_at) SELECT #{accountId}, department.id, 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN', #{actorAccountId}, #{assignedAt} FROM public.department AS department WHERE department.id = #{departmentId} AND department.active RETURNING id

SELECT department.id AS department_id, department.name AS department_name FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = role_assignment.department_id AND department.active WHERE role_assignment.account_id = #{accountId} AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(department.name), department.id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.attendance_day WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND attendance_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_day_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.department WHERE active) AS active_department_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.device WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_device_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.device WHERE status = 'INACTIVE') AS inactive_device_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.device WHERE status = 'REVOKED') AS revoked_device_count

SELECT audit.id, audit.department_id, audit.action, audit.target_type, audit.target_id, audit.reason, audit.occurred_at, account.username AS actor_username FROM public.audit_log AS audit LEFT JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = audit.actor_account_id WHERE audit.action IN ( 'SYSTEM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED', 'DEPARTMENT_CREATED', 'ACCOUNT_CREATED', 'ACCOUNT_DISABLED', 'ACCOUNT_ENABLED', 'ACCOUNT_INVITATION_ISSUED', 'ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_RESET_ISSUED', 'DEPARTMENT_ROLE_ASSIGNED', 'DEPARTMENT_ROLE_REVOKED') ORDER BY audit.occurred_at DESC, audit.id DESC LIMIT 200

INSERT INTO public.account_credential_token( account_id, purpose, token_hash, issued_by_account_id, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{purpose}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuerAccountId}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}) RETURNING id

SELECT token.id AS token_id, token.account_id, account.status AS account_status, token.expires_at FROM public.account_credential_token AS token JOIN public.account AS account ON account.id = token.account_id WHERE token.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND token.purpose = #{purpose} AND token.consumed_at IS NULL AND token.revoked_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF token, account
mapper.update: UPDATE public.account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = #{changedAt}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 'PENDING_SETUP' AND password_hash IS NULL
